senses.gloss: פִּיסַּת ידא the hand up to the wrist; פ׳ כף רגלא the foot up to the ankle.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Kings 18:44">Targ. I Kings XVIII, 44</cite>; a. e.—

<cite ref="Yevamot 115a:7">Yeb. 115ᵃ</cite> <he>פ׳ דידא וכ׳</he> (see) the hand that lies here (of the remains of the burned husband); a. e.—Pl. <cite ref="Q00772"><he>פִּיסָּתָא</he></cite>, constr. <cite ref="Q00744"><he>פִּיסַּת</he></cite>, <he>פִּסַּת</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Samuel 5:4">Targ. I Sam. V, 4</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Esther 8:10">Targ. Esth. VIII, 10</cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 6:2:3">Y. Ber. VI, 10ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>בגין דאנא אכל פִּיסְּתִי … דהדין פסא וכ׳</he> when I eat my bread and, not knowing how to say grace, I say, blessed be he who has created this piece &c. (Bab.

Y. Sabb. VII, end, 10ᵈ קופדה משלים לפ׳ פ׳ וכ׳ meat may serve as a complement to bread (to complete the legal size), but bread cannot serve as a complement to meat. Tanḥ. Ekeb 7, v. לִפְתּוּתָא.—Pl. פִּיסָּתָא crumbs.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 6:4:4">Y. Pes. VI, 33ᶜ</cite> <he>צריך מבערה פ׳</he> must remove the crumbs.
